scenario_steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon visible
ribbon customization shows an initially empty Part Tools target
2D Sketches and 3D Annotations are staged on Part Tools in that order
both commands have Large and Text unchecked
the user clicks the 2D Sketches name in the staged target list
the user presses Ctrl+A while the target list has focus
both staged command rows are highlighted
both commands still have Large and Text unchecked
Part Tools remains marked as having pending changes
